articles.title: Unlocking Revenue Growth Through Human-Made Storytelling Strategies by a Chief Revenue Officer
articles.subtitle: Check out this great article
articles.body:
Local Business Spotlight: Turn Storytelling Into Predictable Revenue
Fellow business owners, here's a strategy worth your attention. 📈
Listing features doesn't close deals anymore. Buyers want to know why your work matters to their goals, their teams, and their bottom line.
Read Why Human Connection through Storytelling Creates Predictable ROI.
Inside, you'll learn how to:
Trade feature-dumping for stories that build trustConnect your offer to real business outcomesUnify marketing, sales, and customer success around one messageTurn human connection into measurable, predictable revenueFor our local owners, CEOs, and founders juggling siloed teams and stretched budgets, this is a practical playbook—not theory. Stronger alignment means faster wins and growth you can actually forecast.
When our community grows smarter together, we all win. 🤝
Read the blog, then schedule a Fractional CRO consultation to map storytelling to your own revenue system.

articles.title: Feeding Medina County is a Nonprofit Partner with Target Circle
articles.subtitle: Shop for a Cause
articles.body:
Feeding Medina County has been selected as a nonprofit partner to receive donations for votes cast from April 1 to June 30.
Vote Now at https://www.target.com/

Login to vote or download the app and shop at Target. Select "My Target" to see how many votes you have available and to cast your vote. If you live outside our market, please use zip code 44256 to find and vote for us. The more votes, the more Target will donate to Feeding Medina County at the end of the campaign!

articles.title: Office Space for Lease in Brunswick/Medina Area
articles.subtitle: Check out this great business space!
articles.body:
Office Space for Lease | Brunswick / Medina AreaCommercial office space available in the northern end of St. Mark Lutheran Church in Brunswick. Suites range from approximately 400–700 square feet, with flexibility depending on your needs.
Our church is seeking more than just a tenant—we hope to partner with a business or organization that serves a meaningful need in the Brunswick and Medina County communities.
Conveniently located on Route 303 in Medina, the property offers easy access to I-71, making it an ideal location for both clients and staff.
If you’re looking for a welcoming, community-centered space to grow your work, we’d love to connect.
📩 Please reach out for more details or to schedule a tour.
